blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine government expects to begin accepting applications for its long-awaited Electric Vehicle Incentive Strategy (Evis) by January 2027, as it seeks to draw automotive manufacturers and establish a domestic electric vehicle (EV) industry. Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo said the program’s implementing rules and regulations (IRR) were nearing completion, with only minor revisions […]...
